title: Greedy improvement and policy iteration
brief: Turn a policy's values into a better policy, then alternate evaluating and improving until the policy stops changing.
hints: greedy_policy: q = rlenvs.q_from_v(mdp, v), then put a 1 at q.argmax(axis=1) in each row. np.argmax already picks the lowest index among ties.
improve_policy evaluates exactly with np.linalg.solve(np.eye(S) - gamma * P_pi, r_pi), then calls greedy_policy on that value. Return the value of the policy you started with, not of the new one.
policy_iteration loops improve_policy. Record the value of every policy you evaluate, and stop when np.array_equal(new_pi, pi) is true.
